nodes.title: Hand 10

Summary (64 hands):
- Preflop SB: Limps 24/49 SB opportunities; RAISED 5/49 (H10: A4s→8, H14: A8o→8, H28: AA→12, H46: 88→8, H60: QQ→8); FOLDED 1/49 (H30).
- SIZING TELL: Raise to 8 = aces (suited/offsuit) OR pocket pairs (88, QQ confirmed). Raise to 12 = AA (1 sample).
- Preflop BB: 3-bets strong hands (1/1, AJd). Otherwise passive.
- Postflop flop (after SB limp, villain initiative): Bets VERY wide — top pair, middle pair, bottom pair, draws (OESD, flush draw, gutshot), AND pure air. 17 flop bets revealed: 7 pair, 5 draws/semi-bluff, 5 pure air.
- *** CRITICAL EXPLOIT ***: NEVER fold to villain's small flop bet (3) with any pair or better. Hero has folded trip kings (H38), trip jacks (H40), top pair ace (H50), set of threes (H52), and bottom pair+A kicker (H58). Always raise or call any pair or better.
- Folds to hero flop raise after villain bet: 2/2 (H24 immediate fold; H22 called then folded turn). KEY EXPLOIT.
- Postflop turn: Raises turn with strong made hand for value (H16: two pair). Turn raise = very strong.
- Folds to turn bet after checking flop passively: 1/1 (H6).
- Folds to flop bet after limp (no initiative): 1/1 (H12).

nodes.title: Bets draws as semi-bluffs on flop
nodes.body:
Villain bets flop with draws (semi-bluff) after SB limp.
- Hand 4: open-ended straight draw (5d 7s on Js 8c 6d), bet 3. Continued as bluff on turn.
- Hand 36: open-ended straight draw (8c Tc on 3c 9d 7s), bet 3. Hero folded.
- Hand 52: flush draw + straight outs (9d Ts on 5d 3d 4c), bet 3. Hero folded SET OF THREES.
- Hand 56: open-ended straight draw (7c 8c on 3c 4d 6d), bet 3. Hero folded 72o (correct).
Count: semi-bluff flop bet with draw 4/4 observed.

nodes.title: Bets wide range on flop after SB limp (pair, draw, or air)
nodes.body: Villain bets flop with nearly any holding after SB limp: top pair, middle pair, bottom pair, draws (OESD, flush draw, gutshot), and pure air/bluffs. 17 flop bets observed with showdown: 7 pair, 5 draws/semi-bluff, 5 pure air. Bet size always 3. Hero should NEVER fold strong hands to this bet — raise or call. Hero has catastrophically folded trips/sets/top pair multiple times.

nodes.title: Double-barrels as bluff/semi-bluff on flop and turn
nodes.body:
Hand 4: Villain bet flop with open-ended straight draw (5d 7s on Js 8c 6d), then fired again on turn (Ts) when draw missed. Opponent folded. Shows willingness to double-barrel with missed draws.
Count: double-barrel bluff observed 1/1 times.

nodes.title: Bluffs flop with air after SB limp
nodes.body:
Villain bets flop after SB limp with complete air (no pair, no draw). Confirmed instances:
- Hand 20: 7d Kh on Td 9s 6h — K-high, pure bluff, bet 3.
- Hand 38: 2s 8d on Kd 7d Ks — total air, bet 3 (hero folded trips).
- Hand 44: 6s Qs on 2s 5d 2d — Q-high, pure bluff, bet 3.
- Hand 48: 2d Jh on Qs Qc Ts — J-high, pure bluff, bet 3.

Count: 4 confirmed flop bluffs with air (showdown-revealed).
Implication: Hero MUST NOT fold to villain's small 3 flop bet. Always raise or call — villain folds to raises 2/2 times.

nodes.title: Folds to flop bet after SB limp when board misses
nodes.body:
When villain limps SB and faces a hero flop bet, villain has folded at least once without a showdown. Suggests limp range is weak and villain does not defend passively with air or marginal hands on the flop.
Count: folded to flop bet after SB limp 1/1 (Hand 12: board 5h 7c 5c, bet 3, fold).

nodes.title: Folds to flop raise after villain bet (after SB limp)
nodes.body: When villain bets flop after SB limp and faces a hero raise, villain has directly folded at least once. Combined with H22 (called flop raise but folded turn), villain's flop betting range is wide and cannot sustain raised pressure — either folds immediately or calls once and then folds to turn barrel.\nCount: direct fold to flop raise 1/1 (H24: Td 8s 6h, bet 3, villain fold to raise-14). Called flop raise then folded turn: 1/1 (H22).\nEXPLOIT: Hero can profitably raise villain's flop bets after SB limp; villain folds or gives up on turn.

nodes.title: Folds to preflop re-raise (BB raise)
nodes.body:
Villain limped/called preflop and folded when BB raised to 8 (4x BB). 
Count: folds to preflop re-raise 1/1. Small sample.

nodes.title: Folds to turn bet when villain checked flop (no initiative)
nodes.body: When villain checks the flop (takes no initiative) and then faces a turn bet, he has folded. Suggests he does not float flop passively and bluff-raise or call turn without something real.\nCount: fold to turn bet after checking flop 1/1 (Hand 6).

nodes.title: Folds to turn bet after calling flop raise
nodes.body: Villain bet the flop, called a hero raise, then folded to a turn barrel. Suggests villain's flop betting/calling range includes weak hands that cannot withstand continued pressure on the turn. Consistent with wide flop bet range (pair, draw, air) — many holdings have no turn equity.\nCount: folds turn after calling flop raise 1/1 (Hand 22: flop 3d 2h Tc, villain bet 3, called raise to 14, folded to 22 on Ad turn).

nodes.title: Limp-calls SB with wide range including suited connectors
nodes.body: Villain limps SB with extremely wide/weak range. Confirmed holdings: 5d7s (H4), 5dKs (H8), 6h5c (H16), 7dKh (H20), Jc3h (H26). Raised SB only with suited aces: Ac4s (H10), As8d (H14). Limps 11/13 SB opportunities total. Range includes pure trash (J3o H26). Implication: SB limp range is extremely wide/weak — flop aggression is well-advised.

nodes.title: 3-bets preflop from BB
nodes.body:
Villain 3-bet from BB when hero raised preflop. Showed AJd — a strong but not top-premium hand. Suggests villain is not purely a 3-bet-or-fold with only premiums; AJs-level hands included.
Count: 3-bet from BB 1/1 opportunities. Sample size: 1.

nodes.title: Raises from SB with strong hands — possible size tell
nodes.body: Raises from SB with strong hands. H10: 4sAc → 8. H14: As8d → 8. H28: AcAs → 12. H46: 8h8d → 8. H60: QsQc → 8. SB raise count: 5/45 SB opportunities. Raise-to-8 range: aces (suited+offsuit) and pocket pairs (88, QQ confirmed). Raise-to-12: AA (once). Hero should treat any SB raise as strong range; fold marginal BB hands.

nodes.title: Raises turn for value with strong made hand
nodes.body: Villain does not just call with strong made hands on the turn — raises for value/to protect. Hand 16: flopped middle pair (6s) on 2s 6c Ad, called turn (5s) improved to two pair (6s & 5s), then raised hero's bet of 7 to 28. Large sizing (4x) suggests strong value hand, not a bluff.\nCount: 1/1 observed turn raises.\nImplication: villain's turn raises should be treated as strong — two pair or better likely. Do not call light vs villain turn raise.

nodes.title: SB raise sizing tell — larger = stronger?
nodes.body: H10 (4sAc) → 8. H14 (As8d) → 8. H28 (AcAs) → 12. H46 (8h8d) → 8. H60 (QsQc) → 8. REVISED: raise-to-8 range includes suited aces, offsuit aces, AND pocket pairs (medium to premium). Raise to 12 = AA (1 sample). Bigger raise still signals near-nutted; raise-to-8 is a wide strong range. Hero should fold marginal hands to any SB raise.

meta.note: Villain folds preflop re-raise from SB (Hand 2) but 3-bets from BB (Hand 3) — likely positional difference, not contradiction per se
